# relay_postgresql_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing managed PostgreSQL cluster in a workspace, by ID or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_postgresql_cluster" "billing" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "billing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_host` (String) Public read-write endpoint host. Empty until the platform publishes it.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Public read-write endpoint port.
- `phase` (String)
- `private_endpoints` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_endpoints))
- `public_endpoints` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_endpoints))
- `ready_nodes` (Number)
- `shared_host` (String) The previous shared read-write address of a database upgraded from the Free plan. It keeps working, but is never `endpoint_host`. Empty when there is no such alias.
- `storage_status` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_status))
- `total_nodes` (Number)
- `version` (String)
